Product Manager – Merchant Payments
Nirvana Ledger (fictional test company) · Bengaluru, India · Hybrid (3 days in office)
Posted 4 days ago

About Nirvana Ledger
Nirvana Ledger is a Series B B2B SaaS company that helps 60,000 small businesses in India collect payments, send invoices and run subscriptions. We raised $40M in 2025.

The role
You will own our merchant checkout and subscription billing products. You will work with 2 engineering squads, design and data to grow payment success and reduce merchant churn.

What you will do
- Own the roadmap for checkout, UPI AutoPay and subscription billing for SMB merchants.
- Run discovery with merchants and turn insights into clear PRDs.
- Define metrics, run A/B tests and report on payment success rate.
- Work with sales and support on go-to-market for new payment features.

What you bring
- 5–8 years of product management experience, ideally in payments or fintech.
- Strong understanding of UPI, cards and subscription billing.
- Experience with SQL or analytics tools to answer your own questions.
- Experience building B2B SaaS products for small businesses.
- Nice to have: experience with mobile apps (Android / iOS).

Compensation
₹30 – 42 LPA fixed + ESOPs.

We prefer candidates who can join within 60 days.
